about: Reasoning questions over the Sample Knowledge Base (the images bundle: user_manual.docx, leave_policy.pdf, quarterly_report.xlsx, performance_metrics.csv, requirements.txt, config.xml, manifest.json). Same format as questions_samples.json, plus expect ('clarify': a vague first question, the right reply asks back) and inferred (true: not stated word for word, worked out from the documents). Types: vague, vague-in-context, inferential, multi-part, compare, follow-up, partial, near-miss (a topic next to what the documents cover).
